subject: world_language
concept: Describing the weather using simple phrases in the target language
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student looks at real or simulated weather and describes it aloud in the target language
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a weather phrase to the correct weather icon
exercise.abstract: Student writes or says a simple weather description in the target language

misconception_flags: confuses similar weather phrases (rainy vs. cloudy) in the target language

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
